# @darcas/rollup-sub-resource-integrity

A zero-dependency Rollup plugin that automatically adds Subresource Integrity (SRI) `integrity`
attributes to the HTML files emitted by your Rollup/Vite build.

It scans the emitted HTML for `<script src>` and `<link rel="stylesheet|preload|modulepreload">`
tags, hashes the matching bundle assets in memory (sha256/sha384/sha512), and injects the
`integrity` attribute — adding `crossorigin="anonymous"` automatically when missing.
